top_signals.title: Asian Bonds, Stocks to Fall as Oil Fans Inflation: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian bonds and stocks were set for further losses Friday as elevated oil prices fueled inflation concerns, driving long-term Treasury yields to multi-decade highs and raising the prospect of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Russia raises taxes to fund its war in Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Moscow to increase dividend tax on foreign investors and introduce windfall taxes on gold and metals producers
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
top_signals.summary: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
